attributes.cardDescription: A raw inbound applicant, pre-evaluation: applicant contact info, source, resume text, and the Position applied to
attributes.readMe:
# Application

## Summary
An unevaluated inbound applicant. Extends `PersonBase`, so `name`, `email`, and `photo` (ImageSourceField — a pasted URL or an uploaded file) are inherited rather than redeclared; `phone` is overridden to the stricter `PhoneNumberField`. Adds `source`, `appliedDate`, `resumeText`, and `status` (new | reviewing | converted | rejected). `position` links to the Position applied for. `title` is computed from `name`.

## Import
```ts
import { Application } from './application';
```

## Usage — three or more ways this is used

**1. As the inbound queue item.** An external application lands here first,
as a person (name/email/phone/photo) plus application-specific facts —
deliberately not a Candidate, because it has not been screened yet.

**2. As the input to screening.** `ScreenApplicationCommand` creates a
Candidate from it, carrying `name`/`email`/`phone`/`photo`/`resumeFile`/`resumeText` across (a real uploaded/pasted photo and the original resume file both survive the conversion instead of being dropped), carries `position` across as a live link, denormalizes `appliedRole` from `position.jobTitle`, and flips this card to `converted`. `referrerName` (free text) resolves to Candidate's `referredBy` (a real `linksTo(Employee)`) only on an unambiguous single name match against existing Employees — an absent or ambiguous match leaves it blank rather than guessing. The command is idempotent — a second run is refused.

**3. As a fitted board tile.** `positionTitle` exists as a denormalized own
attribute precisely so the fitted view never dereferences `position` — a
prerendered fitted card does not resolve `linksTo`, and reading it produced a
dangling `applying for ` fragment.

**4. As an ageing signal.** `appliedDate` feeds `daysWaiting()`; an application
still `new`/`reviewing` after days is what the board flags as needing action.

**5. As a source-attribution record.** `source` and `referrerName` are what
sourcing reports aggregate.

## Template Usage
Every format (isolated/embedded/fitted) shows the real photo when `photo.resolvedUrl` is set, falling back to the inherited `initials` computed field — the same photo-or-initials pattern PersonBase itself uses, not a re-implementation. Fitted adds source and a status pill at badge size; a populated tile adds applied-date and email. The isolated view surfaces the applied-for Position and full resume text.

## Reuse notes
Application is deliberately a *lighter* shape than Candidate (no skills/score/resume-parsing state) — that asymmetry is the point: Application is the mailroom record, Candidate is the evaluated one, and `ScreenApplicationCommand` is the one-way promotion boundary between them. Extending `PersonBase` (rather than `CardDef` with hand-rolled `applicantName`/`applicantEmail`/`applicantPhone` fields, as this card originally did) is what let it pick up photo support for free — a second consumer (e.g. a standalone careers-page intake app) can hold Applications with no Candidate concept at all, and still gets the same person-identity fields every other PersonBase subclass gets.

**Non-goals:** resume parsing (ExtractResumeCommand operates on Candidate, after conversion), duplicate-applicant detection, multi-position applications.
